name: Jay Jalaram Technologies Ltd.
summary: Jay Jalaram Technologies Ltd. is an India-based company primarily engaged in the multi-brand retail selling of electronic gadgets and electric vehicles. The company offers a diverse range of products including smartphones and allied accessories such as 5G smartphones, iPhones, Android phones, tablets, AirPods, earbuds, power banks, and computer accessories. It also retails consumer durable electronics goods like smart TVs, air conditioners, refrigerators, and coolers from various brands. Additionally, the company operates as a dealer for electric bikes, their spare parts, and accessories, specifically under the Revolt brand in the Ahmedabad region. Jay Jalaram Technologies Ltd. serves the Indian market through a network of over 220 retail stores nationwide, operating under its own brands such as KORE, EROK, Simron, and General Electronics, and also distributing products from global and domestic brands including Apple, Samsung, Oppo, Realme, Nokia, Vivo, Xiaomi, Honor, OnePlus, TCL, Haier, Daikin, and Voltas.
